name: Gerard Rijsbrack

summary.text: Gerard Rijsbrack or Gerard Rysbrack was a Flemish painter of still lifes, game pieces, hunting scenes and mythological scenes. He first worked in England and later in Paris where he received royal commissions.
summary.title: Gerard Rijsbrack
